title: Austin Election Set for April 1899
summary:
• **City-wide election scheduled for April 3, 1899** to fill major positions including Mayor, City Marshal, City Clerk, City Attorney, Treasurer, Assessor, Physician, Engineer, seven ward Aldermen, and three school board members.

• **Ordinance faced procedural delays** due to parliamentary disputes over whether the council could reconsider a previously postponed election measure, requiring multiple sessions across three days to resolve.

• **Alderman removed from voting** when it was determined one council member had moved outside his ward and therefore lost voting privileges on city matters.

• **Final passage required rule suspension** to fast-track the election ordinance through its final reading, ultimately passing with 15 aldermen in favor and none opposed.
